author: norwegianbackroad
caption: Mini guide to Bergen 🇳🇴 If you’re heading to Bergen, here are some spots you can't miss: - Go for a hike: reach new heights on the trails of Fløyen or challenge yourself on Løvstakken to enjoy spectacular panoramas of the surrounding fjords. -Walk around the neighbourhoods: lose yourself in the streets of Sandviken and Nordnes to discover the authentic charm of the city's iconic white wooden houses. -Watch the sunset: head up to the Fløyen viewpoints or find a spot by the water at Nordnes Park to watch the sky catch fire. -Try the local food: an unforgettable culinary experience, whether it's fresh local finds at Kaigaten Deli or exceptional seafood at Cornelius. -Cultural visits: step back in time among the leaning wooden warehouses of Bryggen, a UNESCO World Heritage site that tells the story of Bergen's ancient trading history. -Take a break: whether you want a chill spot, a cosy place or just a great cup of coffee (or chocolate!) Bergen’s cafés have you covered! 💙 Would you visit Bergen ? Save this guide for your next visit to Bergen! #bergen #visitnorway #visitbergen #norwaytrip #fjords
